data.name: Abba
data.gender_notes: Abba is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Abba translates to 'father' in Aramaic, which was the language spoken by Jesus and his disciples. It is a term of endearment used to refer to God as a loving and caring father. The name Abba carries the meaning “Father” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Abba usually hope their child will grow to embody father and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the deep connection and love between God and his children.
data.etymology: Abba belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abba total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
